players.name: Henri Veesaar
players.detail: Knee — Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

players.name: Mouhamed Gueye
players.detail: Foot — Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

players.name: Keshon Gilbert
players.detail: Hip — Gilbert (hip) won't play in Saturday's Las Vegas Summer League game against the Wizards, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

players.name: RayJ Dennis
players.detail: Achilles — Dennis (Achilles) has been ruled out for Saturday's Summer League game against the Wizards, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

players.name: Mikel Brown Jr.
players.detail: Ankle — Brown (ankle) hasn't been cleared to practice with contact and remains without a timetable for a return, Brian Lewis of the New York Post reports.

players.name: Kon Knueppel
players.detail: Hamstring — Hornets general manager Jeff Peterson said Monday that he "doesn't know" whether Knueppel (hamstring) will be available for the team's regular-season opener against the Nets, Owen Watterson of SI.com reports.

players.name: Grant Williams
players.detail: Hamstring — Williams will miss the preseason after suffering a right hamstring injury, the Hornets announced Friday.

players.name: PJ Hall
players.detail: Ankle — The Hornets announced Thursday that Hall underwent a procedure to address a fractured right ankle and will miss the remainder of the 2025-26 campaign.

players.name: Zach Collins
players.detail: Toe — Head coach Tiago Splitter said Monday that Collins (toe) is dealing with a soft tissue injury and isn't expected to practice Tuesday, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.

players.name: Peyton Watson
players.detail: Hamstring — Although head coach Kenny Atkinson said the starting lineup for the beginning of the 2026-27 season is not yet set, he praised Watson's (hamstring) fit in Cleveland and added that "there's a lot of room for growth in his offensive game," Chris Fedor of Cleveland.com reports.

players.name: Morez Johnson Jr.
players.detail: Lower Leg — Head coach Dusty May said Wednesday that Johnson has been limited in training camp due to lower-leg soreness, Ron Harrod Jr. of DLLS Sports reports.

players.name: Santi Aldama
players.detail: Undisclosed — Aldama (undisclosed) was limited during Saturday's practice, Noah Weber of TheSmokingCuban.com reported.

players.name: Kyrie Irving
players.detail: Knee — Mavericks president Masai Ujiri offered an encouraging update on Irving's recovery Friday, saying the veteran guard is "right there" as he works toward returning to game action, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.

players.name: Dereck Lively II
players.detail: Foot — Mavericks president Masai Ujiri said Friday that Lively (foot) is "making good progress" in his recovery, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.

players.name: Spencer Jones
players.detail: Hamstring — Jones tweaked his hamstring and did not practice Friday, Harrison Wind of TheDNVR.com reports.

players.name: Trevon Brazile
players.detail: Undisclosed — Brazile is out for Sunday's Summer League finale for undisclosed reasons, Ryan Blackburn of MileHighSports.com reports.

players.name: Jalen Duren
players.detail: Undisclosed — Duren (undisclosed) is not present for the Pistons' open practice Saturday, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.

players.name: Jimmy Butler III
players.detail: Knee — The Warriors hope to have Butler (knee) back early in 2027, per Keith Watkins of Yahoo Sports.

players.name: Kristaps Porzingis
players.detail: Undisclosed — Porzingis is out indefinitely due to an undisclosed issue, Anthony Slater of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Moses Moody
players.detail: Knee — Moody has progressed to light on-court activities as he continues his recovery from a ruptured left patellar tendon, Evan Webeck of The Mercury News reports.

players.name: Alex Toohey
players.detail: Knee — Toohey (knee) signed an Exhibit 10 contract with the Warriors on Wednesday, Anthony Slater of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Larry Nance Jr.
players.detail: Hamstring — Pacers coach Rick Carlisle said Nance is limited to 5-on-0 work at training camp after suffering a hamstring injury just over two weeks ago, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

players.name: Johnny Furphy
players.detail: Knee — Furphy was diagnosed with a torn right ACL on Monday and will miss the remainder of the season, Michael Scotto of USA Today reports.

players.name: Kobe Sanders
players.detail: Hip — Sanders won't play in Sunday's preseason game against the Warriors due to a left hip impingement, Joey Linn of SI.com reports.

players.name: Bradley Beal
players.detail: Knee — Beal (knee) will miss the start of training camp, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
players.detail: Foot — Niederhauser (foot) won't be ready for the start of the season, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Brandon Ingram
players.detail: Achilles — Ingram won't be ready for the start of the season due to a partially torn Achilles, per Joey Linn of SI.com.

players.name: Jordan Miller
players.detail: Shoulder — Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

players.name: Zach Edey
players.detail: Ankle — Edey (ankle) remains on track for Opening Night, per Drew Hill of The Daily Memphian.

players.name: Micah Peavy
players.detail: Ankle — General manager Zach Kleiman said Monday that Peavy recently turned his ankle and it'll be "some time" before the team gets a full look at him, Damichael Cole of The Memphis Commercial Appeal reports.

players.name: Karim Lopez
players.detail: Undisclosed — Lopez (undisclosed) is out for Sunday's Summer League championship game against the Warriors, Drew Hill of The Daily Memphian reports.

players.name: Keshad Johnson
players.detail: Hamstring — Johnson will be sidelined a few weeks with a right hamstring strain, Anthony Chiang of the Miami Herald reports.

players.name: Dru Smith
players.detail: Calf — Smith will miss a couple weeks with a strained right calf, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

players.name: Donte DiVincenzo
players.detail: Achilles — Team president Tim Connelly believes DiVincenzo (Achilles) will return at some point this season, Jack Borman of the Locked On Wolves Podcast reports.

players.name: Bryce McGowens
players.detail: Toe — McGowens (toe) is out for Sunday's game against the Timberwolves.

players.name: Drew Eubanks
players.detail: Thumb — Eubanks (thumb) agreed to a training camp contract with the Knicks on Tuesday, Ian Begley of SportsNet New York reports.

players.name: Thomas Sorber
players.detail: Knee — Sorber will be limited to begin training camp, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

players.name: Nikola Topic
players.detail: Back — Topic (back) will be limited when training camp begins, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports

players.name: Otega Oweh
players.detail: Lower Leg — Oweh (lower leg) didn't play in Sunday's 108-90 Summer League loss to the Nets.

players.name: Noah Penda
players.detail: Hamstring — Penda is nearing a return to full participation after being limited by a hamstring injury during training camp, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

players.name: Anthony Black
players.detail: Ankle — Black is making progress in his recovery from the ankle sprain that has limited him during training camp, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

players.name: Izaiyah Nelson
players.detail: Ankle — Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

players.name: Jonathan Isaac
players.detail: Knee — Isaac (knee) said he will be limited to open training camp, according to Orlando Magic Daily.

players.name: Tacko Fall
players.detail: Hip — Fall was diagnosed with a left hip strain Thursday and will miss at least two weeks, Kyle Neubeck of AllPHLY.com reports.

players.name: Adem Bona
players.detail: Foot — 76ers coach Nick Nurse said Bona (foot) will be re-evaluated in a couple days, Tony Jones of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Mark Williams
players.detail: Shoulder — Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

players.name: Shaedon Sharpe
players.detail: Knee — Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

players.name: David Jones Garcia
players.detail: Ankle — Jones Garcia (ankle) agreed to a two-way contract with the Spurs on Wednesday, per Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com.

players.name: Jayden Quaintance
players.detail: Knee — Quaintance underwent right knee surgery Wednesday and has no timetable for a return, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

players.name: Trayce Jackson-Davis
players.detail: Undisclosed — Jackson-Davis won't play against the Heat in Saturday's preseason game due to undisclosed reasons, according to Josh Lewenberg of TSN.ca.

players.name: Jamison Battle
players.detail: Back — Battle (back) has been ruled out for Saturday's preseason game against the Heat, Josh Lewenberg of TSN.ca reports.

players.name: Kyle Anderson
players.detail: Knee — Anderson (knee) has been ruled out for Saturday's preseason game against the Heat, Josh Lewenberg of TSN.ca reports.

players.name: Allen Graves
players.detail: Groin — Graves (groin) has been ruled out for Saturday's preseason game against the Heat, Josh Lewenberg of TSN.ca reports.

players.name: Kawhi Leonard
players.detail: Not Injury Related — Leonard (not injury related) won't play in Saturday's preseason opener against Miami and is unlikely to suit up for next Saturday's preseason game against the Clippers, Josh Lewenberg of TSN.ca reports.

players.name: Nate Bittle
players.detail: Foot — Bittle (foot) didn't participate in Thursday's scrimmage, Michael Grange of Sportsnet.ca reports.

players.name: Alijah Martin
players.detail: Knee — Martin (knee) won't play in Sunday's Summer League game against the Nuggets, Zulfi Sheikh of Sportsnet reports.

players.name: Chucky Hepburn
players.detail: Knee — Hepburn (knee) won't play in Sunday's Summer League game against the Nuggets, Zulfi Sheikh of Sportsnet reports.

players.name: Trey Alexander
players.detail: Ribs — Alexander (rib) is out for Friday's Summer League game against Portland, per Ben Anderson of KSL News Salt Lake City.

players.name: Alex Sarr
players.detail: Foot — Sarr (foot) didn't participate in Saturday's scrimmage but is expected to ramp up to full contact in the coming days, Josh Robbins of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Tristan Vukcevic
players.detail: Hip — The Wizards announced Thursday that Vukcevic (hip) will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

players.name: Jamir Watkins
players.detail: Knee — The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
